tagline: Leading manufacturer of household and personal care products with strong brand portfolio
hero_kpi_rationale: A voluntary turnover rate of 6.9% demonstrates excellent talent retention and high employee satisfaction, with a year-on-year improvement of -0.8 points. This metric reflects the company's ability to maintain operational stability and a strong corporate culture in a competitive labor market.

kpis.name: Voluntary Turnover Rate
kpis.description: The employee voluntary turnover rate is a key indicator of employee satisfaction and talent retention. A year-on-year reduction of 0.8 points demonstrates improved workforce stability.

kpis.name: Overall Turnover Rate
kpis.explanation: Overall turnover rate including involuntary departures
kpis.description: The overall turnover rate of 24.9% in 2025 reflects workforce reductions related to involuntary actions at Waterpik, the closure of the New Zealand site, and the divestiture of the VMS division. Excluding VMS, the rate would have been 16.8%, below the industry average of 18.7%.

kpis.name: Plant Voluntary Turnover Rate
kpis.explanation: Voluntary turnover rate specific to production facilities
kpis.description: The global plant voluntary turnover rate of 6.9% in 2025, down from 7.9% in 2024, indicates improved retention of production personnel.
kpis.signal: Decline in plant voluntary turnover rate
